subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): session placement, dispatch, and worker turn routing

question: Should milestone 3 land the durable placement, RPC, and runtime foundation before the target-bar UI and agent dispatch tool, once the correctness defect and real-worker proof are resolved?
rationale: The PR creates a substantial durable state and public protocol boundary, while the canonical plan lists additional milestone-3 user surfaces; tests cannot determine the intended release sequencing.

options.title: Land foundation after proof
options.body: Accept this milestone boundary after fixing visible-context adoption and demonstrating the complete configured-worker lifecycle and recovery path.

options.title: Keep milestone atomic
options.body: Hold the PR until the target-bar UI, agent dispatch tool, and remaining milestone-3 surfaces are included or explicitly split into an approved series.

options.title: Narrow the landing
options.body: Retain only prerequisite internal refactors and defer durable placement and `sessions.dispatch` until the complete product path is ready.

recommendation.title: Land foundation after proof
recommendation.body: Accept this milestone boundary after fixing visible-context adoption and demonstrating the complete configured-worker lifecycle and recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical design and the implementation history supplied for this feature converge on this owner.
